### L5 (1)
- [N-000594](../../../sdd/specs/F6_conflicts/spec.md#L87) ✗ A lock hit is replayed; no model call is made (F3 §4.7).

- [N-000291](../../../sdd/specs/F3_atomizer/spec.md#L182) ✗ The run ends with one report (§4.10): blocks processed, nodes formed, blocks that completed and formed no node, with the roles their sentences were given (D33), model calls and usage, every conflict found, and every attention item opened.
- [N-000307](../../../sdd/specs/F3_atomizer/spec.md#L241) ✗ One record per item — a block (Q-ATOM), an atom (Q-DESC), a term (Q-TERM) — not per call (D21).
- [N-000370](../../../sdd/specs/F3_atomizer/spec.md#L429) ✗ A call's usage is stored once (batch_of, CT-3.2) so costs are never counted twice.
